# AIS-IO-02

**Is model output constrained and validated before it reaches a tool, a store, a query, code or a user?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | IO: Inputs and outputs |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.ai.output_handling` |

## Rule

Every ai facet whose output_handling.rendered_as is anything other than displayed text has validated true.
